processing: 字段来源:每个遗物详情页正文只有 {{Infobox_Relic}},真实 id/所属/稀有度/中英文描述/中英文引言 由模板从灰机后端数据库(mw.huiji.db,isRelics=1)渲染。本表用 MediaWiki API `action=parse&section=0` 只取页首 infobox(避开整页巨型导航),用浏览器 DOMParser 按标签精确抽取字段。
忠实保留原站的颜色/变量控制码:部分 effects/flavor 含未渲染的 #b(蓝)、#y(黄)、#r(红)、#g(绿)、#N、#X 等灰机自定义码(模板 _sharp 只转 #b/#y/#r/#p,#g 及引号列原样保留),如『长蛇戒指』的『#g蛇之戒指』、『符文电容器』引文『#b3』。下游展示可按需正则去除。
源站数据错位(已照录,未擅改):个别遗物的『效果英文描述』与『英文引言』在灰机库里被互换,典型如『符文电容器』『橙色药丸』(中文列正确)。另有源站拼写缺陷如『灵体外质』英文缺首字母(『ou can no longer gain Gold』)。均按原样保留并在此标注。
文本清洗:仅去除换行/制表、合并连续空格、剔除紧邻全角标点(。，、；：！？）)前后的多余空格;不改动 # 控制码、数字两侧空格与措辞。
命名:部分遗物存在同名/易混名(如 两种『戒指』『符文』系列、玩家与敌人相关项),以 中文标题(name) 唯一;title 字段记录重定向解析后的真实页名,便于核对。

relics.name: 燃烧之血
relics.effects_zhs: 在战斗结束时，回复6点生命。
relics.effects_en: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP
relics.flavor_zhs: 你自身的血液因为无尽的愤怒而燃烧沸腾。
relics.flavor_en: Your body's own blood burns with an undying rage.
relics.title: 燃烧之血

relics.name: 蛇之戒指
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，额外抽 2 张牌。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 用蛇的化石制成的戒指，优秀女猎手的象征。
relics.flavor_en: Made from a fossilized snake. Represents great skill as a huntress.
relics.title: 蛇之戒指

relics.name: 破损核心
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时， 生成 1 个 闪电 充能球。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 #y Lightning.
relics.flavor_zhs: 高塔所有自动机器人体内都有的神秘生命力之源，这个似乎已经有一点破损了
relics.flavor_en: The mysterious life force which powers the Automatons within the Spire. It appears to be cracked.
relics.title: 破损核心

relics.name: 至纯之水
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张 奇迹 放入你的手牌。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, add a Miracle into your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 用极细的沙粒过滤的水，去除了一切杂质。
relics.flavor_en: Filtered through fine sand and free of impurities.
relics.title: 至纯之水

relics.name: 弹珠袋
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人 1层 易伤
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, apply 3,Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 曾经这在城市区是流行的玩具，现在你可以用它让敌人们失去平衡。
relics.flavor_en: A once popular toy in the City. Useful for throwing enemies off balance.
relics.title: 弹珠袋

relics.name: 小血瓶
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，回复 2 点生命。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 装着纯种年长吸血鬼血液的一个小瓶。
relics.flavor_en: A vial containing the blood of a pure and elder vampire.
relics.title: 小血瓶

relics.name: 铜制鳞片
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，获得 3点 荆棘
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 3 Thorns.
relics.flavor_zhs: 守护者身上的锐利鳞片，会自动变形来保护使用者。
relics.flavor_en: The sharp scales of the Guardian. Rearranges itself to protect its user.
relics.title: 铜制鳞片

relics.name: 百年积木
relics.effects_zhs: 你在每场战斗中第一次损伤生命时，抽 3 张牌。
relics.effects_en: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw 3 cards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 解开积木的谜题时，你感到心中有一股强大的暖意。
relics.flavor_en: Upon solving the puzzle, you feel a powerful warmth in your chest.
relics.title: 百年积木

relics.name: 数据磁盘
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，获得 1 点 集中
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 1 Focus.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这张磁盘里记录了关于鸟类和蛇类的珍贵数据。
relics.flavor_en: This disk contains precious data on birds and snakes.
relics.title: 数据磁盘

relics.name: 发条靴
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你造成小于等于 5点 未被格挡的 攻击 伤害时，将伤害提升为 5。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you would deal 4 or less unblocked Attack damage, increase it to 5.
relics.flavor_zhs: 拧动发条会让这只靴子变得更大。
relics.flavor_en: When wound up, the boot grows larger in size.
relics.title: 发条靴

relics.name: 捕梦网
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你 休息 时，可以增加一张牌到你的牌组。
relics.effects_en: "Whenever you Rest, you may add a card into your deck.
relics.flavor_zhs: 北方部落会在入睡时挂上这种网，相信这样做能够实现自我提升。
relics.flavor_en: The northern tribes would often use dream catchers at night, believing they led to self improvement.
relics.title: 捕梦网

relics.name: 开心小花
relics.effects_zhs: 每 3 个回合，获得一点能量。
relics.effects_en: Every 3 turns, gain 1 energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这朵一直面带笑容的花是贵族间流行的小礼物。
relics.flavor_en: This unceasingly joyous plant is a popular novelty item among nobles.
relics.title: 开心小花

relics.name: 灯笼
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗的第一回合获得一点能量。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with an additional energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一盏诡异的灯笼，只为提灯者照明。
relics.flavor_en: An eerie lantern which illuminates only for the wielder.
relics.title: 灯笼

relics.name: 意外光滑的石头
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，获得 1 点 敏捷。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 1 Dexterity.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你从没有见过这么光滑完好的东西，这一定是出自先古之民的手艺。
relics.flavor_en: You have never seen something so smooth and pristine. This must be the work of the Ancients.
relics.title: 意外光滑的石头

relics.name: 御守
relics.effects_zhs: 抵消你下 2 次获得的 诅咒。
relics.effects_en: Negate the next 2 Curses you obtain.
relics.flavor_zhs: 常见的用来抵御邪灵的护身符，这个护符里似乎有一股神圣的能量。
relics.flavor_en: A common charm for staving off vile spirits. This one seems to possess a spark of divine energy.
relics.title: 御守

relics.name: 奥利哈钢
relics.effects_zhs: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何 格挡，获得 6点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: If you end your turn without Block, gain 6 Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一块出处不明、带着些绿色的金属。似乎完全不会毁坏。
relics.flavor_en: A green tinted metal of an unknown origin. Seemingly indestructible.
relics.title: 奥利哈钢

relics.name: 红头骨
relics.effects_zhs: 当你的生命值等于或低于 50% 时， 你获得额外 3点 力量。
relics.effects_en: While your HP is at or below 50%, you have 3 additional Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一个用装饰性颜料涂红的小小头骨。
relics.flavor_en: A small skull covered in ornamental paint.
relics.title: 红头骨

relics.name: 皇家枕头
relics.effects_zhs: 在 休息 时额外回复 15 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you Rest, heal an additional 15 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这下能好好睡一觉了。
relics.flavor_en: Now you can get a proper night's rest.
relics.title: 皇家枕头

relics.name: 微笑面具
relics.effects_zhs: 商人的卡牌移除服务现在价格永远是 50 金币。
relics.effects_en: The Merchant's card removal service now always costs 50 Gold.
relics.flavor_zhs: 商人戴着的面具，看来他有很多备用的……
relics.flavor_en: Mask worn by the Merchant. He must have spares...
relics.title: 微笑面具

relics.name: 异蛇头骨
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你给予敌人 中毒 状态时，额外给予 1层 中毒
relics.effects_en: Whenever you apply Poison, apply an additional 1 Poison.
relics.flavor_zhs: 保存完好的异蛇头骨，十分离奇地非常干净和光滑，任何灰尘和污垢都无法沾上它，这是为什么呢。
relics.flavor_en: A snecko skull in pristine condition. Mysteriously clean and smooth, dirt and grime fall off inexplicably.
relics.title: 异蛇头骨

relics.name: 草莓
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升 7.
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7
relics.flavor_zhs: 太好吃了！荒疫之后就没见过这东西了啊。”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: Delicious! Haven't seen any of these since the blight.\" - Ranwid
relics.title: 草莓

relics.name: 药水腰带
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，获得 2 个药水栏位。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, gain 2 Potion slots.
relics.flavor_zhs: 穿上这条腰带，我就能携带更多药水！
relics.flavor_en: I can hold more Potions using this belt!
relics.title: 药水腰带

relics.name: 小宝箱
relics.effects_zhs: 每 4个？ 房间的最后一个必是 宝箱房。
relics.effects_en: Every 4th ? room is a Treasure room.
relics.flavor_zhs: 作为原型而言相当不错。”——建筑师
relics.flavor_en: \"A fine prototype.\" - The Architect
relics.title: 小宝箱

relics.name: 金刚杵
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，获得 1 点 力量。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 1 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一件交给在战斗中展示了荣耀的战士们的装饰性遗物。
relics.flavor_en: An ornamental relic given to warriors displaying glory in battle.
relics.title: 金刚杵

relics.name: 磨刀石
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，随机 升级 2 张 攻击牌。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Attacks.
relics.flavor_zhs: “肉体永远无法打败钢铁。”——忽必烈大帝
relics.flavor_en: \"Flesh never beats steel.\" - Kublai the Great
relics.title: 磨刀石

relics.name: 餐券
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你进入商店房间时，回复 15 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you enter a shop, heal 15 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: “这里的肉丸子可是有名的！以后每次来都可以尝尝哦！”
relics.flavor_en: \"Complimentary meatballs with every visit!\"
relics.title: 餐券

relics.name: 巨口储蓄罐
relics.effects_zhs: 每攀爬一层楼层获得 12 金币。一旦在商店中花费 金币 就会失效。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you climb a floor, gain 12 Gold. No longer works when you spend any 12 Gold at the shop.
relics.flavor_zhs: 尽管巨口袭击频繁发生，这个造型的储蓄罐却意外相当流行。
relics.flavor_en: Surprisingly popular, despite maw attacks being a regular occurrence.
relics.title: 巨口储蓄罐

relics.name: 双节棍
relics.effects_zhs: 你每打出 10张 攻击牌，获得一点能量。
relics.effects_en: Every time you play 10 Attacks, gain 1 energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 优良的练武器具，能改善使用者的姿势、提升灵活度。
relics.flavor_en: A good training tool. Improves the posture and agility of the wielder.
relics.title: 双节棍

relics.name: 昆虫标本
relics.effects_zhs: 精英战中的敌人生命减少 25%。
relics.effects_en: Enemies in Elite combats have 25% less HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这只昆虫似乎会对尤其巨大的敌人们散发出虚弱的光环。
relics.flavor_en: The insect seems to create a shrinking aura that targets particularly large enemies.
relics.title: 昆虫标本

relics.name: 陶瓷小鱼
relics.effects_zhs: 每次你往自己的牌组中加入一张卡牌时，获得 9 金币。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you add a card to your deck, gain 9 gold.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这些被精心上色的鱼儿被认为可以带来滚滚财源。
relics.flavor_en: Meticulously painted, these fish were revered to bring great fortune.
relics.title: 陶瓷小鱼

relics.name: 赤牛
relics.effects_zhs: 你在每场战斗中的第一次攻击造成 8 点额外伤害
relics.effects_en: Your first Attack each combat deals 8 additional damage.
relics.flavor_zhs: 哞～
relics.flavor_en: "Muuu~"
relics.title: 赤牛

relics.name: 手摇鼓
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的回合开始时，获得 1 层 真言。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Mantra.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这面小鼓的声音让你时刻保持神志清醒，仿佛能看见前方何处才有道路。
relics.flavor_en: The sound of the small drum keeps your mind awake, revealing a path forward.
relics.title: 手摇鼓

relics.name: 钢笔尖
relics.effects_zhs: 你每打出的第 10 张 攻击牌 将会造成双倍伤害。
relics.effects_en: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.
relics.flavor_zhs: 拿着这支笔尖时，你可以看见所有被笔尖前主人杀死过的人。真是血腥的历史。
relics.flavor_en: Holding the nib, you can see everyone ever slain by a previous owner of the pen. A violent history.
relics.title: 钢笔尖

relics.name: 战纹涂料
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，随机 升级 2 张 技能牌。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Skills.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在过去，铁甲军团的士兵们会在战斗前使用带有魔力的涂料来绘制保护性的战纹。
relics.flavor_en: In the past, Ironclads would create wards using enchanted war paint before charging into battle.
relics.title: 战纹涂料

relics.name: 玩具扑翼飞机
relics.effects_zhs: 你每使用一瓶 药水，回复 5 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you use a potion, heal 5 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个小玩具最适合陪伴孤独一人的冒险者啦！
relics.flavor_en: "This little toy is the perfect companion for the lone adventurer!"
relics.title: 玩具扑翼飞机

relics.name: 佛珠手链
relics.effects_zhs: 你在 ? 房间中不会再遭遇常规战斗。
relics.effects_en: Normal enemy combats are no longer encountered in ? rooms.
relics.flavor_zhs: 抵御未知危险的护身道具。
relics.flavor_en: A ward against the unknown.
relics.title: 佛珠手链

relics.name: 准备背包
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，额外抽 2 张牌。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards
relics.flavor_zhs: 冒险者专用的超大号背包，有很多口袋和皮带。
relics.flavor_en: Oversized adventurer's pack. Has many pockets and straps.
relics.title: 准备背包

relics.name: 锚
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时获得 10点 格挡
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with #b Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 拿着这个小小的装饰，你觉得自己更稳也更重了。
relics.flavor_en: Holding this miniature trinket, you feel heavier and more stable.
relics.title: 锚

relics.name: 古茶具套装
relics.effects_zhs: 到达休息处后的下一场战斗开始时获得2点能量。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, start the next combat with 2 energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 能让你神清气爽睡得香。
relics.flavor_en: The key to a refreshing night's rest.
relics.title: 古茶具套装

relics.name: 孙子兵法
relics.effects_zhs: 如果你在回合中不打出任何 攻击牌，在下一回合得到一点额外能量。
relics.effects_en: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional energy next turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这本古兵书记载着远古时代的智慧。
relics.flavor_en: This ancient manuscript contains wisdom from a past age.
relics.title: 孙子兵法

relics.name: 送货员
relics.effects_zhs: 商人的卡牌、遗物和药水不再会卖光，并且所有商品打折 20%。
relics.effects_en: The Merchant's personal pet!
relics.flavor_zhs: 这是商人的宠物！
relics.flavor_en: The Merchant restocks cards, relics, and potions. All prices are reduced by #b20%.
relics.title: 送货员

relics.name: 蓝蜡烛
relics.effects_zhs: 可以打出原本 不能被打出 的 诅咒牌， 打出 诅咒牌 会让你失去 1 点生命并将其 消耗。
relics.effects_en: Unplayable Curse cards can now be played. Whenever you play a Curse, lose 1 HP and Exhaust it.
relics.flavor_zhs: 当处于黑暗中时，这支蜡烛会自动点燃。
relics.flavor_en: The flame ignites when shrouded in darkness.
relics.title: 蓝蜡烛

relics.name: 瓶装火焰
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，选择一张 攻击牌。在每场战斗开始时，这张牌会出现在手牌中。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, choose an Attack. Start each combat with this card in your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在这个瓶子里，有着一团永远燃烧的火焰。
relics.flavor_en: Inside the bottle resides a flame that eternally burns.
relics.title: 瓶装火焰

relics.name: 瓶装闪电
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，选择一张 技能牌。在每场战斗开始时，这张牌会出现在手牌中。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, choose a Skill. Start each combat with this card in your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 细看这团旋转的雷云，你仿佛能看见自己的一部分在回望着你。
relics.flavor_en: Peering into the swirling maelstrom, you see a part of yourself staring back.
relics.title: 瓶装闪电

relics.name: 瓶装旋风
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，选择一张 能力牌。在每场战斗开始时，这张牌会出现在手牌中。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, choose a Power card. Start each combat with this card in your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个瓶子中传来轻轻的嗡嗡声与嗖嗖声。
relics.flavor_en: The bottle gently hums and whirs.
relics.title: 瓶装旋风

relics.name: 镀金缆线
relics.effects_zhs: 你最右侧的充能球会额外触发一次被动效果。
relics.effects_en: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
relics.flavor_zhs: “有意思！看来就连自动机器人也会有安慰剂效应。”——兰伟德"
relics.flavor_en: "Interesting! Even automatons are affected by placebo." - Ranwid
relics.title: 镀金缆线

relics.name: 永恒羽毛
relics.effects_zhs: 你牌组中每有 5 张牌，当你进入休息处时就会回复 3 点生命。
relics.effects_en: For every 5 cards in your deck, heal 3 HP whenever you enter a Rest Site.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这片羽毛似乎完全无法摧毁，会是从什么鸟身上来的呢？
relics.flavor_en: This feather appears to be completely indestructible. What bird does this possibly come from?
relics.title: 永恒羽毛

relics.name: 冻结之蛋
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你获得 能力牌 时，将其 升级。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you add a Power card to your deck, it is Upgraded.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个蛋冻结着，没有丝毫生气，永远也不会孵化。
relics.flavor_en: The egg lies inert and frozen, never to hatch.
relics.title: 冻结之蛋

relics.name: 黑石护符
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你获得一张 诅咒，将你的最大生命值提高 6
relics.effects_en: Whenever you obtain a Curse, increase your Max HP by 6
relics.flavor_zhs: 这块黑石能吸取黑暗的能量，将其转化为佩戴者的生命力。
relics.flavor_en: The stone draws power from dark energy, converting it into vitality for the wearer.
relics.title: 黑石护符

relics.name: 地精之角
relics.effects_zhs: 每当有一名敌人死亡，获得1点能量并抽 1 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever an enemy dies, gain an energy and draw 1 card.
relics.flavor_zhs: “地精大块头到死都能一直长得更大，真是厉害。”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: Gremlin Nobs are capable of growing until the day they die. Remarkable. - Ranwid
relics.title: 地精之角

relics.name: 苦无
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在同一回合内打出 3 张 攻击牌，获得 1点 敏捷。
relics.effects_en: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Dexterity.
relics.flavor_zhs: 受到刺客喜爱的远距离利刃。
relics.flavor_en: A blade favored by assassins for its lethality at range.
relics.title: 苦无

relics.name: 开信刀
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在同一回合内打出 3 张技能牌，对所有敌人造成 5 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: Every time you play 3 Skills in a single turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 锋利到不自然。
relics.flavor_en: Unnaturally sharp.
relics.title: 开信刀

relics.name: 套娃
relics.effects_zhs: 你接下来打开的 2 个宝箱内会有 2 件 遗物。 （Boss宝箱除外）
relics.effects_en: The next 2 non-Boss chests you open contain 2 Relics.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一套环环相套的娃娃，上面的图案是一只白眼蓝羽毛的鸟，你不知道这是只什么鸟。
relics.flavor_en: A stackable set of painted dolls. The paint depicts an unknown bird with white eyes and blue feathers.
relics.title: 套娃

relics.name: 带骨肉
relics.effects_zhs: 如果你在战斗结束时生命值等于或低于 50%，回复 12 点生命。
relics.effects_en: If your HP is at or below 50% at the end of combat, heal 12 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这块肉会不断恢复，似乎永远也不会彻底吃光。
relics.flavor_en: The meat keeps replenishing, never seeming to fully run out.
relics.title: 带骨肉

relics.name: 水银沙漏
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成 3 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一个附加魔力的沙漏，一直都在不断滴下水银。
relics.flavor_en: An enchanted hourglass that endlessly drips.
relics.title: 水银沙漏

relics.name: 熔火之蛋
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你获得 攻击牌 时，将其 升级。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you add an Attack into your deck, Upgrade it.
relics.flavor_zhs: 凤凰的蛋，可以看到有岩浆在滋滋发热，红得发烫。
relics.flavor_en: The egg of a Phoenix. It glows red hot with a simmering lava.
relics.title: 熔火之蛋

relics.name: 干瘪之手
relics.effects_zhs: 你每打出一张 能力牌，手牌中就有一张随机牌在这个回合耗能变为 0。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you play a Power card, a random card in your hand costs 0 that turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这只手经常都在抽动，尤其是在你心跳很快的时候。
relics.flavor_en: Frequently twitches, especially when your pulse is high.
relics.title: 干瘪之手

relics.name: 忍术卷轴
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时，手牌中增加 3 张 小刀。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, add 3 Shivs into your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 暗杀秘术尽在其中。
relics.flavor_en: Contains the secrets of assassination.
relics.title: 忍术卷轴

relics.name: 精致折扇
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在同一回合内打出 3 张 攻击牌，就获得 4 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 4 Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这把折扇似乎会在洒到血时自动伸展并且变硬。
relics.flavor_en: The fan seems to extend and harden as blood is spilled.
relics.title: 精致折扇

relics.name: 缩放仪
relics.effects_zhs: 在Boss战开始时，回复 25点 #生命值。
relics.effects_en: At the start of Boss combats, heal 25 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: “坚实的地基从不是出自偶然，规划工具是重中之重。”——建筑师
relics.flavor_en: Solid foundations are not accidental. Tools for planning are a must.\ - The Architect
relics.title: 缩放仪

relics.name: 纸鹤
relics.effects_zhs: 有 虚弱 状态的敌人造成的伤害降低 40% 而非 25%。
relics.effects_en: Enemies with Weak deal 40% less damage rather than 25%.
relics.flavor_zhs: 某种过去时代生物的折纸。
relics.flavor_en: An origami of a creature from a past age.
relics.title: 纸鹤

relics.name: 纸蛙
relics.effects_zhs: 有 易伤 状态的敌人受到的伤害增加 75% 而非 50%。
relics.effects_en: Enemies with Vulnerable take 75% more damage rather than 50%.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这张纸似乎会不断自己翻折，变成某种小动物的形状。
relics.flavor_en: The paper continually folds and unfolds itself into the shape of a small creature.
relics.title: 纸蛙

relics.name: 梨子
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升 10.
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 10.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在高塔荒疫发生之前十分常见的水果。
relics.flavor_en: A common fruit before the Spireblight.
relics.title: 梨子

relics.name: 问号牌
relics.effects_zhs: 在选奖励牌时，可供选择的牌数增加 1 张。（拾起时同一窗口中的奖励牌不受影响）
relics.effects_en: Future card rewards have 1 additional card to choose from.
relics.flavor_zhs: “选择多，则不受其乱。”——忽必烈大帝
relics.flavor_en: Those with more choices minimize the downside to chaos.- Kublai the Great
relics.title: 问号牌

relics.name: 自成型黏土
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你在战斗中失去生命，就在下回合获得 3 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block next turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: “真是有意思！这东西看起来可以按照我的想法自己成型！读心的黏土吗？”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: Most curious! It appears to form itself loosely on my thoughts! Tele-clay? - Ranwid
relics.title: 自成型黏土

relics.name: 手里剑
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在同一回合内打出 3 张 攻击牌，获得 1点 力量。
relics.effects_en: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 轻型的投掷武器，尤其推荐对着眼睛扔。
relics.flavor_en: Lightweight throwing weapons. Recommend going for the eyes.
relics.title: 手里剑

relics.name: 颂钵
relics.effects_zhs: 可以将卡牌奖励转变为 +2 最大生命值。
relics.effects_en: When adding cards into your deck, you may raise your Max HP by 2 instead.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这件被使用过无数次的法器在被敲打时会发出不绝于耳的悠扬旋律，也被称为“唱歌碗”。
relics.flavor_en: This well-used artifact rings out with a beautiful melody when struck.
relics.title: 颂钵

relics.name: 共生病毒
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时， 生成 1 个 黑暗 充能球。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Dark.
relics.flavor_zhs: 小小的麻烦，却可以带来大大的益处……
relics.flavor_en: A little bit of bad can do a lot of good...
relics.title: 共生病毒

relics.name: 毒素之蛋
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你获得 技能牌 时，将其 升级。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you add a Skill into your deck, Upgrade it.
relics.flavor_zhs: “真是了不起的发现！这似乎是某种魔法生物已经不起作用了的蛋，究竟是谁或什么制造了这东西呢？”——兰伟德"
relics.flavor_en: What a marvelous discovery! This appears to be the inert egg of some magical creature. Who or what created this? - Ranwid
relics.title: 毒素之蛋

relics.name: 白兽雕像
relics.effects_zhs: 战斗结束后必定掉落药水
relics.effects_en: Potions always appear in combat rewards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一个小小的白色雕像，这种动物你从来没有见过。
relics.flavor_en: A small white statue of a creature you have never seen before.
relics.title: 白兽雕像

relics.name: 两仪
relics.effects_zhs: 每回合中，你每次打出一张 攻击牌，获得 1 点临时 敏捷。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you play an Attack, gain 1 temporary Dexterity.
relics.flavor_zhs: “于是太阳永远熄灭了，如同天幕在其之前坠下。”——佐罗斯"
relics.flavor_en: And the sun was extinguished forever, as if curtains fell before it. - Zoroth
relics.title: 两仪

relics.name: 墨水瓶
relics.effects_zhs: 你每打出 10 张牌，抽 1 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you play 10 cards, draw 1 card.
relics.flavor_zhs: 每次用光，都会自动装满一种颜色不同的墨水。
relics.flavor_en: Once exhausted, appears to refill itself in a different color.
relics.title: 墨水瓶

relics.name: 打击木偶
relics.effects_zhs: 名字中有“打击”的卡牌造成 3 点额外伤害。
relics.effects_en: Cards containing \"Strike\" deal 3 additional damage.
relics.flavor_zhs: 被打得破破烂烂的。
relics.flavor_en: It's beat up.
relics.title: 打击木偶

relics.name: 泪滴吊坠盒
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时处于 平静。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat in Calm.
relics.flavor_zhs: 盒子的主人双目失明，其中的东西无人知晓。
relics.flavor_en: Its owner blind, its contents unseen.
relics.title: 泪滴吊坠盒

relics.name: 船夹板
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的第二回合开始时，获得 14 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your 2nd turn, gain 14 Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 拿在手里有一种莫名的愉悦感，这是什么东西呢？
relics.flavor_en: Pleasant to hold in the hand. What was it for?
relics.title: 船夹板

relics.name: 日晷
relics.effects_zhs: 你每洗牌 3次，获得2点能量。
relics.effects_en: Every 3 times you shuffle your draw pile, gain 2 energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: “古代人类愚昧地执着于时间，他们抬头望向天空，希望能得到永恒的引导。”——佐罗斯"
relics.flavor_en: Early man's foolish obsession with time caused them to look to the sky for guidance, hoping for something permanent." - Zoroth
relics.title: 日晷

relics.name: 香炉
relics.effects_zhs: 每 6 回合，获得 1 层 无实体。
relics.effects_en: Every 6 turns, gain 1 Intangible.
relics.flavor_zhs: 香炉中的烟让拥有者获得被焚烧者的灵力。
relics.flavor_en: The smoke imbues its owner with the spirit of the burned.
relics.title: 香炉

relics.name: 历石
relics.effects_zhs: 在第 7 回合结束时，对所有敌人造成 52 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: At the end of turn #b, deal #b damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在高塔中几乎感觉不到时间的流逝。
relics.flavor_en: The passage of time is imperceptible in the Spire.
relics.title: 历石

relics.name: 怀表
relics.effects_zhs: 若你在某个回合打出的牌少于等于 3 张，则在你的下个回合开始时额外抽 3 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you play 3 or less cards during your turn, draw 3 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 指针似乎永远卡在3点的位置。
relics.flavor_en: The hands seem stuck on the 3 o'clock position.
relics.title: 怀表

relics.name: 螺类化石
relics.effects_zhs: 阻止你在每场战斗中第一次受到的生命值损伤。
relics.effects_en: Prevent the first time you would lose HP each combat.
relics.flavor_zhs: 似乎坚不可摧，你很好奇究竟是何种生物曾拥有这样的部分。
relics.flavor_en: Seemingly indestructible, you wonder what kind of creature this belonged to.
relics.title: 螺类化石

relics.name: 羽翼之靴
relics.effects_zhs: 你在选择下一层的房间时有3次机会可以无视当前的路线。
relics.effects_en: You may ignore paths when choosing the next room to travel to 3 times.
relics.flavor_zhs: 很帅气。
relics.flavor_en: Stylish.
relics.title: 羽翼之靴

relics.name: 斗篷扣
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的回合结束时，每有一张手牌获得 1 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Block for each card in your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 设计简约但牢固。
relics.flavor_en: A simple but sturdy design.
relics.title: 斗篷扣

relics.name: 钨合金棍
relics.effects_zhs: 你每次失去生命时，减少失去的生命值 1 点。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you would lose HP, lose 1 less.
relics.flavor_zhs: 非常非常重
relics.flavor_en: It's very very heavy.
relics.title: 钨合金棍

relics.name: 舵盘
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的第三回合开始时，获得 18 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain 18 Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 精雕细琢的木质物件，上面用陌生的语言刻着一个名字。
relics.flavor_en: Wooden trinket carved with delicate precision. A name is carved into it but the language is foreign.
relics.title: 舵盘

relics.name: 黄金眼
relics.effects_zhs: 你每次 预见 时，额外 预见 2 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you Scry, Scry 2 additional cards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 能够看见近处生灵的心智，让你可以预判他们将来的动作。
relics.flavor_en: See into the minds of those nearby, predicting their future moves.
relics.title: 黄金眼

relics.name: 赌博筹码
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，丢弃任意张牌，然后抽相同数量张牌。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你能看见筹码的一面上刻着一行小字：“熊的幸运筹码！
relics.flavor_en: You can see a small inscription on one side. It reads: "Bear's Lucky Chip!"
relics.title: 赌博筹码

relics.name: 鸟面瓮
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你打出一张 能力牌，回复 2 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you play a Power card, heal 2 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个瓮上雕着乌鸦之神Mazaleth嘲弄的样貌。
relics.flavor_en: This urn shows the crow god Mazaleth looking mischievous.
relics.title: 鸟面瓮

relics.name: 外卡钳
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的回合开始时，不再失去所有 格挡，而是失去 15 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block rather than all of your Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 机械精度正是通向崇高之路。”——建筑师
relics.flavor_en: "Mechanical precision leads to greatness" - The Architect"
relics.title: 外卡钳

relics.name: 冠军腰带
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你给予 易伤 时，同时给予 1 层 虚弱。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you apply Vulnerable, apply 1 Weak.
relics.flavor_zhs: 只有最强者才配佩戴这条腰带。
relics.flavor_en: Only the greatest may wear this belt.
relics.title: 冠军腰带

relics.name: 卡戎之灰
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你 消耗 一张牌，对所有敌人造成 3 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 传说中卡戎是重生的神祇，永远都在烈焰之中反复地死亡和重生。
relics.flavor_en: Charon was said to be the god of rebirth, eternally dying and reviving in a burst of flame.
relics.title: 卡戎之灰

relics.name: 毒巫娃娃
relics.effects_zhs: 你的牌组中每有一张 诅咒 牌，你在战斗开始时就额外获得 1点 力量。
relics.effects_en: For each Curse in your deck, start each combat with 1 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一个设计为能从邪恶能量中获得力量的娃娃。
relics.flavor_en: A doll devised to gain strength from malicious energy.
relics.title: 毒巫娃娃

relics.name: 枯木树枝
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你 消耗 一张牌，增加一张随机卡牌到你的手牌。
relics.effects_en: The branch of a tree from a forgotten era.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一个早已被遗忘的时代所遗留下来的树木枝条。
relics.flavor_en: Whenever you #yExhaust a card, add a random card into your hand.
relics.title: 枯木树枝

relics.name: 情感芯片
relics.effects_zhs: 在每回合开始时，如果你在之前回合受到过伤害，则触发所有充能球的被动效果。
relics.effects_en: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.
relics.title: 情感芯片

relics.name: 生姜
relics.effects_zhs: 你不会再被 虚弱。
relics.effects_en: You can no longer become Weakened.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在许多补品中都能用上的好东西。
relics.flavor_en: A potent tool in many tonics.
relics.title: 生姜

relics.name: 壶铃
relics.effects_zhs: 你现在能在休息处获得 力量。（最多3次）
relics.effects_en: You can now gain Strength at Rest Sites (up to 3 times).
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个壶铃重到难以想象，用这个锻炼一定能变得更强。
relics.flavor_en: This Girya is unfathomably heavy. You could train with this to get significantly stronger.
relics.title: 壶铃

relics.name: 冰淇淋
relics.effects_zhs: 多余的能量可以留到下一回合。
relics.effects_en: Energy is now conserved between turns.
relics.flavor_zhs: “好吃！”
relics.flavor_en: Delicious!
relics.title: 冰淇淋

relics.name: 蜥蜴尾巴
relics.effects_zhs: 当你要被杀死时，免死并回复到最大生命值的 50% （仅能起效一次）。
relics.effects_en: When you would die, heal to 50% of your Max HP instead (works once).
relics.flavor_zhs: 在战斗中可以用来骗过敌人的假尾巴。
relics.flavor_en: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat.
relics.title: 蜥蜴尾巴

relics.name: 魔法花
relics.effects_zhs: 战斗中的回复效果提升 50%。
relics.effects_en: Healing is 50% more effective during combat.
relics.flavor_zhs: 被认为是早已绝种的一朵花，竟被完美地保存了下来。
relics.flavor_en: A flower long thought extinct, somehow preserved in perfect condition.
relics.title: 魔法花

relics.name: 芒果
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升 14。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 14.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在众多被遗忘的水果中最令人垂涎的一种。被完美地保存了下来，没有任何受到高塔荒疫影响的迹象。
relics.flavor_en: The most coveted forgotten fruit. Impeccably preserved with no signs of Spireblight.
relics.title: 芒果

relics.name: 古钱币
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，获得 300 金币
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, gain 300 Gold.
relics.flavor_zhs: 因为其历史价值和稀有金属成分而被商人出以高价的独特钱币。
relics.flavor_en: Unique coins are highly valued by merchants for their historical value and rare metallic composition.
relics.title: 古钱币

relics.name: 宁静烟斗
relics.effects_zhs: 现在你可以在休息处移除你牌组中的牌。
relics.effects_en: You can now remove cards from your deck at Rest Sites.
relics.flavor_zhs: 放空心智，洁净灵魂。
relics.flavor_en: Clears the mind and cleanses the soul.
relics.title: 宁静烟斗

relics.name: 转经轮
relics.effects_zhs: 普通敌人多掉落一次卡牌奖励。
relics.effects_en: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
relics.flavor_zhs: 经轮一直转动，永远不停。
relics.flavor_en: The wheel continues to spin, never stopping.
relics.title: 转经轮

relics.name: 铲子
relics.effects_zhs: 现在你可以在休息处 挖掘 遗物。
relics.effects_en: You can now Dig for relics at Rest Sites.
relics.flavor_zhs: 高塔中有着无数过去文明遗留下的遗物和强大的冒险者们遗失的宝物，现在你可以把它们挖出来了！
relics.flavor_en: The Spire houses all number of relics from past civilizations and powerful adventurers lost to time. Time to go dig them up!
relics.title: 铲子

relics.name: 萝卜
relics.effects_zhs: 你不会再被 脆弱。
relics.effects_en: You can no longer become Frail.
relics.flavor_zhs: 与生姜搭配尤为适合
relics.flavor_en: Best with Ginger."
relics.title: 萝卜

relics.name: 生物样本
relics.effects_zhs: 每当有敌人死去时，将其身上的 中毒 层数移到一名随机敌人身上。
relics.effects_en: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Poison it has to a random enemy.
relics.flavor_zhs: “有意思！我发现了一个有着惊人毒性的变异生物，先采集份样本以后再仔细研究吧。”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: Fascinating! I found a mutated creature demonstrating astounding toxic properties. Storing a sample for later examination.- Ranwid
relics.title: 生物样本

relics.name: 针线
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，获得 4层 多层护甲。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 4 Plated Armor.
relics.flavor_zhs: 将这些魔法线缠绕在你的周围时，你觉得自己变得更坚硬了。
relics.flavor_en: Wrapping the magical thread around your body, you feel harder to the touch.
relics.title: 针线

relics.name: 铜钹
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就对一名随机敌人造成 3 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这件乐器发出的响声似乎能回荡到让人耳朵发痛。
relics.flavor_en: The sound this instrument generates seems to be capable of reverberating to painful levels of volume.
relics.title: 铜钹

relics.name: 鸟居
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你受到小于等于 5点的未被格挡 攻击 伤害时，将伤害降低为 1。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you would receive 5 or less unblocked attack damage, reduce it to 1.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你拿着这个小小的鸟居，感觉心中有一股宁静与安全的感觉。
relics.flavor_en: Holding the small Torii, you feel a sense of calm and safety drift through your mind.
relics.title: 鸟居

relics.name: 结实绷带
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就获得 3点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain 3 Block.
relics.flavor_zhs: 失去给人带来力量
relics.flavor_en: Loss gives strength.
relics.title: 结实绷带

relics.name: 不休陀螺
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的回合，当你没有手牌时，抽一张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you have no cards in hand during your turn, draw a card.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个陀螺始终轻松地旋转着，让你觉得自己仿佛是在梦中。
relics.flavor_en: The top continues to spin effortlessly as if you were in a dream.
relics.title: 不休陀螺

relics.name: 星盘
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，选择 3 张牌进行 变化，然后将这些牌 升级。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, Transform 3 cards, then Upgrade them.
relics.flavor_zhs: 可以从星星中探知宝贵知识的工具。
relics.flavor_en: A tool to glean invaluable knowledge from the stars.
relics.title: 星盘

relics.name: 黑暗之血
relics.effects_zhs: 替换 燃烧之血。在战斗结束时，回复 12点生命。
relics.effects_en: Replaces Burning Blood. At the end of combat, heal 12 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你的愤怒变得更加黑暗。
relics.flavor_en: The rage grows darker.
relics.title: 黑暗之血

relics.name: 黑星
relics.effects_zhs: 精英 敌人在被打败时多掉落一件 遗物。
relics.effects_en: Elites drop an additional relic when defeated.
relics.flavor_zhs: 最初在蛇镇上发现的遗物，当时被放在一根蜡烛旁边。
relics.flavor_en: Originally discovered in the town of the serpent, beside a solitary candle.
relics.title: 黑星

relics.name: 召唤铃铛
relics.effects_zhs: 获得一个独特的 诅咒 和 3 件 遗物。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, obtain a unique Curse and 3 relics.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个黑铁铃铛在你找到它时作响了3次，但现在它已经不再响了。
relics.flavor_en: his dark iron bell rang 3 times when you found it, but now stays silent.
relics.title: 召唤铃铛

relics.name: 诅咒钥匙
relics.effects_zhs: 你每次打开一个非Boss宝箱，都会获得一张 诅咒。在每回合开始时获得一点能量。
relics.effects_en: at the start of your turn.gain 1 energy. Whenever you open a non-Boss chest, obtain a Curse.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你能感到这把钥匙上散发出邪恶的能量。力量总是需要付出代价的。
relics.flavor_en: You can feel the malicious energy emanating from the key. Power comes at a price.
relics.title: 诅咒钥匙

relics.name: 机械臂
relics.effects_zhs: 每 2 回合，获得 1 个充能球栏位。
relics.effects_en: Every 2 turns, gain 1 Orb slot.
relics.flavor_zhs: 抓取。放置。堆叠。重复。
relics.flavor_en: Push. Pull. Stack. Repeat.
relics.title: 机械臂

relics.name: 痛楚印记
relics.effects_zhs: 每回合开始获得 [R]。在战斗开始时，将 2 张 伤口 放入你的抽牌堆。
relics.effects_en: Gain [R] at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle 2 Wounds into your draw pile.
relics.flavor_zhs: 北方部落中使用这个工具来给那些在战斗中掌握痛楚的战士们打上烙印。
relics.flavor_en: This brand was used by the northern tribes to signify warriors who had mastered pain in battle.
relics.title: 痛楚印记

relics.name: 核能电池
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时， 生成 1 个 等离子 充能球。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Plasma.
relics.flavor_zhs: 哇噢……
relics.flavor_en: Ooooh...
relics.title: 核能电池

relics.name: 潘多拉魔盒
relics.effects_zhs: 变化 所有“打击”和“防御”牌。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, Transform all Strike and Defend cards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你觉得打开这个盒子会很不吉利。
relics.flavor_en: You have a bad feeling about opening this.
relics.title: 潘多拉魔盒

relics.name: 贤者之石
relics.effects_zhs: 在每回合开始时获得1点能量。所有敌人初始获得 1点 力量。
relics.effects_en: Gain an energy at the start of your turn. ALL enemies start combat with 1 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这块石头中散发出纯粹的能量，所有周围的人与物都会因此而变强。
relics.flavor_en: Raw energy emanates from the stone, empowering all nearby.
relics.title: 贤者之石

relics.name: 长蛇戒指
relics.effects_zhs: 替换 #g蛇之戒指。在你的每个回合开始时，额外抽 1 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Replaces #gRing #gof #gthe #gSnake.At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你的戒指改变了形态，焕然一新。
relics.flavor_en: Your ring has morphed and changed forms.
relics.title: 长蛇戒指

relics.name: 符文立方体
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你失去生命时，抽 1 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card.
relics.flavor_zhs: 上面的符文无法辨识。
relics.flavor_en: The runes are indecipherable.
relics.title: 符文立方体

relics.name: 符文圆顶
relics.effects_zhs: 你无法再看见敌人的 意图。在每回合开始时获得一点能量。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn gain an energy. You can no longer see enemy intents.
relics.flavor_zhs: 上面的符文无法辨识
relics.flavor_en: The runes are indecipherable.
relics.title: 符文圆顶

relics.name: 符文金字塔
relics.effects_zhs: 你在回合结束时不再自动丢弃所有手牌。
relics.effects_en: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 上面的符文无法辨识
relics.flavor_en: The runes are indecipherable.
relics.title: 符文金字塔

relics.name: 异蛇之眼
relics.effects_zhs: 每回合多抽 2 张牌。每场战斗开始时获得 混乱 效果。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, draw 2 additional cards. Start each combat Confused.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一条死去异蛇的眼珠，比你想象中的要大上不少。
relics.flavor_en: An eye of a fallen snecko. Much larger than you imagined.
relics.title: 异蛇之眼

relics.name: 添水
relics.effects_zhs: 你无法再获得药水。在每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer obtain potions.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你注意到所有带魔力的液体在接近这件遗物时都会失去效力。
relics.flavor_en: You notice that magical liquids seem to lose their properties when near this relic.
relics.title: 添水

relics.name: 灵体外质
relics.effects_zhs: 你不能再获得任何 金币。在回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: ou can no longer gain Gold.Gain an energy at the start of your turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这团黏液与能量的混合物微微脉动，仿佛有着生命。
relics.flavor_en: This blob of slime and energy seems to pulse with life.
relics.title: 灵体外质

relics.name: 小屋子
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，获得 1 瓶药水。 获得 50 金币。 将你的最大生命值提升 5。 获得 1 张牌。 随机升级 1 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, obtain 1 potion. Gain 50 Gold. Raise your Max HP by #b. Obtain 1 card. Upgrade 1 random card.
relics.flavor_zhs: “一项近乎完美的微缩化工程。这是我至今最优秀的作品，但仍然远远不够。”——建筑师
relics.flavor_en: A near perfect implementation of miniaturization. My finest work to date, but still not adequate. - The Architect
relics.title: 小屋子

relics.name: 天鹅绒颈圈
relics.effects_zhs: 你每回合不能打出超过 6 张牌。在每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: Gain an energy at the start of your turn. You cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: “力量巨大，但过于局限。”——忽必烈大帝
relics.flavor_en: Immense power, but too limited. - Kublai the Great
relics.title: 天鹅绒颈圈

relics.name: 破碎金冠
relics.effects_zhs: 在卡牌奖励画面，可供选择的牌数减少 2 张。在每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: Gain an energy at the start of your turn. Future card rewards have 2 less cards to choose from.
relics.flavor_zhs: 第一勇士的金冠……或者只是一个拙劣的仿制品？
relics.flavor_en: The Champ's crown... or a pale imitation?
relics.title: 破碎金冠

relics.name: 空鸟笼
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，选择移除牌组中的 2 张牌。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, remove 2 cards from your deck.Choose 2 Cards to Remove.
relics.flavor_zhs: “将崇拜之物关进笼子，这是多么奇异的行为啊。”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: "How unusual to cage that which you worship." - Ranwid
relics.title: 空鸟笼

relics.name: 融合之锤
relics.effects_zhs: 你无法再在休息处锻造升级卡牌。每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: Gain an energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一旦握住，就永远无法放下。
relics.flavor_en: Once wielded, the owner can never let go.
relics.title: 融合之锤

relics.name: 咖啡滤杯
relics.effects_zhs: 你无法再在休息处 休息。在每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: Gain an energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Rest at Rest Sites.
relics.flavor_zhs: “好的，请再来一杯。继续工作，继续工作！”——建筑师"
relics.flavor_en: Yes, another cup please. Back to work. Back to work! - The Architect
relics.title: 咖啡滤杯

relics.name: 悬浮风筝
relics.effects_zhs: 你在每回合第一次弃牌时，获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: The first time you discard a card each turn,gain an energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 风筝在战斗中飘浮在你的身旁，不知是何种神秘的力量让它能浮在空中。
relics.flavor_en: The Kite floats around you in battle, propelled by a mysterious force.
relics.title: 悬浮风筝

relics.name: 冻结核心
relics.effects_zhs: 替换 破损核心。 如果你在你的回合结束时还有空余的充能球栏位， 生成 1 个 冰霜 充能球。
relics.effects_en: Replaces Cracked Core.If you end your turn with empty Orb slots.Channel 1 Forest orb.
relics.flavor_zhs: 某种脉动的冰冷能量充满了你核心中的破损处。
relics.flavor_en: The crack in your core has been filled with a pulsating cold energy.
relics.title: 冻结核心

relics.name: 袖剑
relics.effects_zhs: 费用为0的 攻击牌 额外造成 4 点伤害。
relics.effects_en: Attacks that cost 0 deal 4 additional damage.
relics.flavor_zhs: 实用的暗杀工具。
relics.flavor_en: Handy for assassinations.
relics.title: 袖剑

relics.name: 圣水
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，将 3 张 奇迹 放入你的手牌。
relics.effects_en: Replaces Pure Water. At the start of each combat, add 3 Miracles into your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 从高塔出现的时代前收集来的水。
relics.flavor_en: Collected from a time before the Spire.
relics.title: 圣水

relics.name: 神圣树皮
relics.effects_zhs: 药水的效果翻倍。
relics.effects_en: Double the effectiveness of potions.
relics.flavor_zhs: 传说中来自于世界树上的一块树皮。
relics.flavor_en: A bark rumored to originate from the World tree.
relics.title: 神圣树皮

relics.name: 紫色莲花
relics.effects_zhs: 每次你离开 平静 时，获得1点额外能量。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you exit Calm, gain an additional energy.
relics.flavor_zhs: 远古的经书上记载着，“法力池”的水面上总是有许多这些花朵。
relics.flavor_en: The old texts describe that the surface of \"mana pools\" were littered with these flowers.
relics.title: 紫色莲花

relics.name: 奴隶贩子颈环
relics.effects_zhs: 在Boss战与精英战中，你在每回合开始时获得1点能量。
relics.effects_en: During Boss and Elite combats, gain [E] at the start of your turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 锈蚀可憎的铁链。
relics.flavor_en: Rusty miserable chains.
relics.title: 奴隶贩子颈环

relics.name: 鲜血神像
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你获得 金币 时，回复 5 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you gain Gold, heal 5 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这个神像现在一直在流着血泪。
relics.flavor_en: The idol now weeps a constant stream of blood.
relics.title: 鲜血神像

relics.name: 英雄宝典
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时增加一张随机 能力牌 到你的手牌，这张牌在第一回合的耗能变为 0。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, add a random Power card to your hand. It costs 0 until the end of turn.
relics.flavor_zhs: 一名古老巫妖的传奇日志。
relics.flavor_en: The legendary journal of an ancient lich.
relics.title: 英雄宝典

relics.name: 金神像
relics.effects_zhs: 敌人掉落的 金币 增加 25%。
relics.effects_en: Enemies drop 25% more Gold.
relics.flavor_zhs: 用纯金制成，只是拿在手里就让你觉得自己有钱了。
relics.flavor_en: Made of solid gold, you feel richer just holding it.
relics.title: 金神像

relics.name: 死灵之书
relics.effects_zhs: 你每回合打出的第一张耗能大于等于 2 的 攻击牌 将被打出两次。当你拾起这件遗物时，被 诅咒。
relics.effects_en: The first Attack played each turn that costs 2 or more is played twice. Upon pickup, obtain a special Curse.
relics.flavor_zhs: 只有傻瓜才会想要去掌控这种邪恶的力量。你每晚的梦境中都充斥着这本书将你的心智逐渐吞噬的噩梦。
relics.flavor_en: Only a fool would try and harness this evil power. At night your dreams are haunted by images of the book devouring your mind.
relics.title: 死灵之书

relics.name: 涅奥的悲恸
relics.effects_zhs: 接下来 3 场战斗中的敌人将只有 1 点生命。
relics.effects_en: Enemies in your first 3 combats will have 1 HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: 涅奥赐予你的祝福，有着悲恸之力。
relics.flavor_en: The blessing of lamentation bestowed by Neow.
relics.title: 涅奥的悲恸

relics.name: 尼利的宝典
relics.effects_zhs: 在每回合结束时，你可以从 3 张随机牌中选择 1 张，随机洗入你的抽牌堆。
relics.effects_en: At the end of your turn, you may shuffle 1 of 3 random cards into your draw pile.
relics.flavor_zhs: 由臭名昭著的游戏大师本人编制，据说能拓宽人的心智。
relics.flavor_en: Crafted by the infamous game master himself. Said to expand one's mind.
relics.title: 尼利的宝典

relics.name: 恩洛斯的礼物
relics.effects_zhs: 使你在怪物奖励中遇见稀有牌的几率变为 3 倍。
relics.effects_en: Triples the chance of receiving rare cards as monster rewards.
relics.flavor_zhs: 恩洛斯给你的奇怪礼物，每次你试着拆开包装时，都会从里面找到另一个相同大小且包装完好的盒子。
relics.flavor_en: The strange gift from N'loth. Whenever you try and unwrap it, another wrapped box of the same size lies within.
relics.title: 恩洛斯的礼物

relics.name: 奇怪蘑菇
relics.effects_zhs: 当你有 易伤 状态时，受到的额外伤害从 50% 下降为 25%。
relics.effects_en: When Vulnerable, take 25% more attack damage rather than 50%.
relics.flavor_zhs: 吃了寄生毛菇之后，我觉得自己更高大了，也更……不容易受伤了。”——兰伟德
relics.flavor_en: After consuming trichella parastius I felt larger and less... susceptible. - Ranwid
relics.title: 奇怪蘑菇

relics.name: 精灵便便
relics.effects_zhs: 不管怎么看都很不舒服
relics.effects_en: It's unpleasant.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你向精灵献上的祭品被烧焦后的遗留物。
relics.flavor_en: The charred remains of your offering to the spirits.
relics.title: 精灵便便

relics.name: 绽放印记
relics.effects_zhs: 你无法再回复生命。
relics.effects_en: You can no longer heal.
relics.flavor_zhs: 在高塔的深处，思维与现实成为了一体。
relics.flavor_en: In the Beyond, thoughts and reality are one.
relics.title: 绽放印记

relics.name: 蛇的头
relics.effects_zhs: 每次进入？房间时获得 50 金币。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you enter a ? room, gain 50 Gold.
relics.flavor_zhs: 最幸福的人生当然就是什么东西都能买得起的土豪生活了！
relics.flavor_en: The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can buy anything!
relics.title: 蛇的头

relics.name: 恩洛斯的饥饿的脸
relics.effects_zhs: 你打开的下一个非Boss宝箱将是空的。
relics.effects_en: The next non-Boss chest you open is empty.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你觉得好饿。
relics.flavor_en: You feel hungry."
relics.title: 恩洛斯的饥饿的脸

relics.name: 牧师的脸
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗后你的最大生命值增加 1。
relics.effects_en: At the end of combat, raise your Max HP by 1
relics.flavor_zhs: 人人都爱牧师。
relics.flavor_en: Everyone loves Cleric.
relics.title: 牧师的脸

relics.name: 邪教徒头套
relics.effects_zhs: 你觉得自己有开腔的欲望
relics.effects_en: You feel more talkative.
relics.flavor_zhs: 自己人！自己人！
relics.flavor_en: Part of the Flock!
relics.title: 邪教徒头套

relics.name: 地精容貌
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，你拥有 1 层 虚弱。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 1 Weak.
relics.flavor_zhs: 呜哇，好想逃跑。
relics.flavor_en: Time to run.
relics.title: 地精容貌

relics.name: 突变之力
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时获得 3 点 力量，在你的第一个回合结束时失去 3 点 力量。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 3 Strength. At the end of your first turn, lose 3 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: “效果似乎稍纵即逝，只在危险时才会触发。”——佚名
relics.flavor_en: "The results seem fleeting, triggering when the subject is in danger." - Unknown
relics.title: 突变之力

relics.name: 红面具
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人 1 层 虚弱。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这副看起来十分帅气的面具属于红面具强盗团的头子，这么说来，现在你应该是他们的老大了？
relics.flavor_en: This very stylish looking mask belongs to the leader of the Red Mask Bandits. Technically that makes you the leader now?
relics.title: 红面具

relics.name: 弯曲铁钳
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的每个回合开始时，随机 升级 一张你的手牌（只影响本场战斗）。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, Upgrade a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
relics.flavor_zhs: 这对被偷来的诅咒铁钳上散发着强烈的怨念，它似乎十分想要回到原本的地方。
relics.flavor_en: The cursed tongs emit a strong desire to return to where they were stolen from.
relics.title: 弯曲铁钳

relics.name: 大锅
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，制作 5 瓶随机药水。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, brews 5 random potions.
relics.flavor_zhs: 商人其实是位技术相当不错的药剂师。买四送一。
relics.flavor_en: The Merchant is actually a rather skilled potion brewer. Buy 4 get 1 free.
relics.title: 大锅

relics.name: 化学物X
relics.effects_zhs: 耗能为 X 的牌的效果数值增加 2 点。
relics.effects_en: The effects of your cost X cards are increased by 2.
relics.flavor_zhs: 警告：严禁与糖、香料还有一切美好的味道混合在一起。
relics.flavor_en: WARNING: Do not combine with sugar, spice, and everything nice.
relics.title: 化学物X

relics.name: 冻结之眼
relics.effects_zhs: 现在观看 抽牌堆 时，卡牌将按顺序排列。
relics.effects_en: When viewing your Draw Pile, the cards are now shown in order.
relics.flavor_zhs: 凝视这只眼睛时，你能隐约捕捉到你自己的未来。
relics.flavor_en: Staring into the eye, you see a glimpse of your future.
relics.title: 冻结之眼

relics.name: 李家华夫饼
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升 7 点，并回复所有生命。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7 and heal all of your HP.
relics.flavor_zhs: “全高塔你能找到的最好吃的东西！今天特地为你烤的。”
relics.flavor_en: Tastiest treat you will find in all the Spire! Baked today just for you.
relics.title: 李家华夫饼

relics.name: 医药箱
relics.effects_zhs: 可以打出原本 不能被打出 的 状态牌。 打出 状态牌 会将其 消耗。
relics.effects_en: Unplayable Status cards can now be played. Whenever you play a Status card, Exhaust it.
relics.flavor_zhs: “什么都有！治痒痒、治烧伤、治中毒，应有尽有！”
relics.flavor_en: Has everything you need! Anti-itch, anti-burn, anti-venom, and more!
relics.title: 医药箱

relics.name: 会员卡
relics.effects_zhs: 所有商品打折 50%！
relics.effects_en: 50% discount on all products!
relics.flavor_zhs: “会员资格！只有本店最尊贵的客人，才有机会获得哦！”
relics.flavor_en: Bonus membership offer for my most valuable customers!
relics.title: 会员卡

relics.name: 星系仪
relics.effects_zhs: 从五组三选一的卡牌中选择 5 张牌加入你的牌组。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, choose and add 5 cards to your deck.
relics.flavor_zhs: “一旦你理解了宇宙……”——佐罗斯",
relics.flavor_en: Once you understand the universe... - Zoroth
relics.title: 星系仪

relics.name: 符文电容器
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时，获得 3 个额外充能球栏位。
relics.effects_en: More is better.
relics.flavor_zhs: 多多益善。
relics.flavor_en: Start each combat with #b3 additional Orb slots.
relics.title: 符文电容器

relics.name: 奇怪的勺子
relics.effects_zhs: 应该 消耗 的牌在被打出时会有 50% 几率只被丢弃。
relics.effects_en: Cards which Exhaust when played will instead discard 50% of the time.
relics.flavor_zhs: 如果你盯着这把勺子看，它似乎就会在你眼前弯曲变形。
relics.flavor_en: Staring at the spoon, it appears to bend and twist around before your eyes.
relics.title: 奇怪的勺子

relics.name: 工具箱
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，你可以从 3 张随机无色牌中选择 1 张增加到你的手牌。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your hand.
relics.flavor_zhs: 不管面对什么工作，都能找到相应的工具。
relics.flavor_en: A tool for every job.
relics.title: 工具箱

relics.name: 算盘
relics.effects_zhs: 你每次将抽牌堆洗牌时，获得 6 点 格挡。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, gain 6 Block.
relics.flavor_en: One...Two...Three…
relics.title: 算盘

relics.name: 多利之镜
relics.effects_zhs: 拾起时，从你的牌组中选择一张牌进行复制。
relics.effects_en: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your deck.
relics.flavor_zhs: “照出来我的样子怪怪的。”
relics.flavor_en: I look funny in this.
relics.title: 多利之镜

relics.name: 齿轮工艺品
relics.effects_zhs: 每场战斗开始时，获得 1 层 人工制品。
relics.effects_en: Start each combat with 1 Artifact.
relics.flavor_zhs: “你看里面齿轮这么多，是不是很精巧。”
relics.flavor_en: So many intricate gears.
relics.title: 齿轮工艺品

relics.name: 扭曲漏斗
relics.effects_zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人 4 层 中毒。
relics.effects_en: At the start of each combat, apply 4 Poison to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor_zhs: “个人建议不要用这个来喝东西。”
relics.flavor_en: I wouldn't drink out of it.
relics.title: 扭曲漏斗

relics.name: 手钻
relics.effects_zhs: 每当你突破敌人的 格挡 时，给予其 2 层 易伤。
relics.effects_en: Whenever you break an enemy's Block, apply 2 Vulnerable.
relics.flavor_zhs: “螺旋超危险的啊。”
relics.flavor_en: Spirals are dangerous.
relics.title: 手钻

relics.name: 勇气投石索
relics.effects_zhs: 在与精英敌人战斗时，获得 2 点 力量。
relics.effects_en: Start each Elite combat with 2 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: “对格外强大的对手非常好用的工具。”
relics.flavor_en: A handy tool for dealing with particularly tough opponents.
relics.title: 勇气投石索

relics.name: 橙色药丸
relics.effects_zhs: 你每在同一回合内打出 能力牌、 攻击牌 和 技能牌 各一张，移除你身上的所有负面效果。
relics.effects_en: Made from various fungi found throughout the Spire, they will stave off any affliction.
relics.flavor_zhs: “用塔里各处真菌做出来的药，包治百病！”
relics.flavor_en: Whenever you play a #yPower, #yAttack, and #ySkill in the same turn, remove all of your debuffs.
relics.title: 橙色药丸

relics.name: 硫磺
relics.effects_zhs: 在你的每个回合开始时，你获得 2 点 力量，所有敌人也获得 1 力量。
relics.effects_en: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Strength and ALL enemies gain 1 Strength.
relics.flavor_zhs: 散发出地狱般的高热。
relics.flavor_en: Emanates an infernal heat.
relics.title: 硫磺

relics.name: 棱镜碎片
relics.effects_zhs: 战斗奖励掉落的卡牌现在会包括无色牌和其他颜色的牌。
relics.effects_en: Combat reward screens now contain Colorless cards and cards from other colors.
relics.flavor_zhs: 通过碎片，你能以全新的视角观察这个世界。
relics.flavor_en: Looking through the shard, you are able to see entirely new perspectives.
relics.title: 棱镜碎片

relics.name: 美琅脂
relics.effects_zhs: 你每次将抽牌堆洗牌时， 预见 3.
relics.effects_en: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, Scry 3
relics.flavor_zhs: 来源不明的神秘沙子，气味有点像肉桂。
relics.flavor_en: Mysterious sands from an unknown origin. Smells of cinnamon.
relics.title: 美琅脂

relics.name: 头环
relics.effects_zhs: 多多益善。
relics.effects_en: Collect as many as you can.
relics.flavor_zhs: 你已经没有更多遗物可以拿了。厉害！
relics.flavor_en: You ran out of relics to find. Impressive!
relics.title: 头环
